system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
systemPrompt: input.systemContext?.instructions
? { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: input.systemContext.instructions }
system_prompt_style.note: Claude Code preset plus appended per-group instructions; settingSources project/user/local load CLAUDE.md files.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `TOOL_ALLOWLIST` (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task, Skill, …)
env_context_strategy.note: Assistant domain; per-group CLAUDE.md also injected.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: **PreCompact** hook archives the transcript to `conversations/` before compaction
context_compaction.note: Compaction is performed by the Claude Agent SDK; transcript rotation (12 MB / 14 days) also drops old continuations.

observation_format.note: Tool observation formatting is delegated to Claude Agent SDK; not shown in evidence.

tool_count.note: TOOL_ALLOWLIST is elided with '…' in the evidence; full list not visible.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `TOOL_ALLOWLIST` (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task, Skill, …)
edit_primitive.note: Inferred from Claude Code Edit/Write tool names.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: `container/agent-runner/` — Bun agent-runner: poll loop, MCP tools, provider abstraction
tool_schema_source.note: Schema production code not shown; MCP servers are registered.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent-runner inside the container polls `inbound.db`, runs the agent, and writes responses to `outbound.db`.
loop_primitives.note: Inner loop is Claude Agent SDK ReAct; outer message-driven poll loop and scheduled tasks.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `SDK_DISALLOWED_TOOLS` blocks SDK builtins that collide with NanoClaw's own scheduling/interaction model (CronCreate/Delete/List, ScheduleWakeup, AskUserQuestion, Enter/ExitPlanMode, Enter/ExitWorktree)
planning_granularity.note: Plan mode tools disabled; TodoWrite status unknown due to elided allowlist.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: `TOOL_ALLOWLIST` (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task, Skill, …)
multi_agent_topology.note: Task tool allows subagents; teammate agents can be spawned from chat (README).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: May be emitted multiple times per query (e.g., Claude's multi-turn with subagents).
delegation_mechanism.note: Task tool in default allowlist spawns SDK subagents.

human_in_loop.note: AskUserQuestion disallowed; users interact via chat messages.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the agent-runner stores one opaque `continuation` token per provider

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: each agent group has its own `CLAUDE.md`, its own memory, its own container, and only the mounts you allow.
long_term_memory.note: Skills loaded per group (groups/<folder>/ skills); memory templates in container/agent-runner/src/memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Resume via the SDK `resume` option keyed on the stored `continuation` (the SDK session ID)

self_verification.note: No verification mechanism described in available docs excerpt.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `retryable` indicates whether the agent-runner should retry.

rollback.note: Tool registry elided; rollback not determinable.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `result` — emitted when the agent produces a complete response.
termination_condition.note: Host idle ceiling and stale detection also exist.

cost_controls.note: OneCLI rate limits mentioned; no token budget code in evidence.

timeouts.evidence_quote: records the current tool + its declared timeout to `container_state` (so the host sweep widens its stuck tolerance while a long Bash runs)
timeouts.note: Host idle ceiling may act as per-run limit.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: agents are sandboxed in Docker containers (macOS/Linux/WSL2)

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: They can only access explicitly mounted directories.

network_policy.evidence_quote: outbound API requests route through [OneCLI's Agent Vault](https://github.com/onecli/onecli), which injects authentication at the proxy level and supports rate limits and access policies.
network_policy.note: Proxy with access policies; web access is available, so closest value uncertain.

tracing.evidence_quote: Claude persists its own `.jsonl` transcript on disk keyed by the continuation (session ID).

replayability.note: No replay facility in evidence excerpt.

eval_hooks.note: File tree truncated; no evaluation runner visible.

guardrails.evidence_quote: as defense-in-depth, blocks any `SDK_DISALLOWED_TOOLS` call that slips through.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps,, has memory, scheduled jobs, and runs directly on Anthropic's Agents SDK

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Provider is configurable per agent group.
model_agnostic.note: Default Claude only; others via skills.
